fullDesc: On October 12, 2019 in Vienna, Eliud Kipchoge ran a marathon in 1 hour 59 minutes 40 seconds. It was not an official record because of rotating pacers and other aids, but it showed the distance could be run under two hours.
realFacts: He set the official marathon record of 2:01:09 in Berlin in 2022
Pacing and shoes helped his time
He won Olympic gold in 2016 and 2020
